moment_kmeans: Scalar kmeans with K=3, 8 initializations and 100 iterations on the same empirical g. Transfer only the resulting I; all C and amplitude are fresh.
moment_balanced_groups: Sort the 24 empirical moment coordinates and divide into 3 groups of 8, using the known balanced-group grammar but no learned library. Fit all C fresh.
moment_dense: Dense input direction initializes from the same empirical g, normalized to each of eight declared radii; amplitude is fresh. Four starts per radius and 2048 steps, total 65536 updates. Use the previous frozen dense Adam/SGDM learning rates. Query chooses among all radii and starts.
scope: Supplementary strong controls declared after observing moment routing success in cue-present and failure in frequency-6 cue-absent runs. Evaluate all four existing conditions, without selecting hyperparameters on them. These are post-hoc controls on the same cohort, not a new confirmatory holdout.
invariant: Task-derived numerical initialization is an explicitly separate competitor. The primary method still transfers only I and initializes all numerical values independently.
